name: Confero
client_reviews: Contractors praise Confero for its clear instructions and flexible scheduling, but some express frustration with the low pay per evaluation.

name: Secret Shopper
client_reviews: Contractors generally report flexible scheduling and fair pay, but occasionally note inconsistent assignment availability and reimbursement processes.

name: Pearson VUE
client_reviews: Contractors appreciate the flexibility of on-site and remote proctoring opportunities, but some report variable scheduling and pay rates.

name: CS Field Services
client_reviews: Contractors generally report timely payments and a straightforward workflow, but note that the per-unit pay can be on the lower side for some service types.

name: Kryterion (now PSI)
client_reviews: Contractors praise the flexibility of remote work opportunities, but some report inconsistent scheduling and pay rates.

name: Shiner Exteriors
client_reviews: Employees value the competitive compensation for hard work and the positive, family-oriented culture, although some note the fast-paced nature of administrative roles.

name: KY Field Services
client_reviews: Contractors generally report timely payments and a straightforward workflow with KY Field Services.

name: Total Care Medical Courier
client_reviews: Contractors report consistent and reliable payment from Total Care Medical Courier, but occasionally experience communication delays with dispatchers.

name: NSF International
client_reviews: Noted for brilliant colleagues and comprehensive travel expense coverage for auditors, but many report a recent decline in work-life balance and uncompetitive pay scales.

name: Vision Realty & Management
client_reviews: Property inspectors enjoy a flexible work schedule and solid benefits, along with the stability of a long-established professional management environment.
